author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.79 shipped: Bill prediction uses SmartHub cost and tracks its accuracy
summary: Bill prediction uses SmartHub cost and tracks its accuracy
why: Operator wanted a 1-2 week extrapolation that tracks actuals so accuracy is visible over time. The straight line on URA cost ran 20-34% low; SmartHub statistics now give real cost to date. A D0 backtest over 4 cycles picked same-weekday pricing for the remainder (15% error at days 7/14 vs 32-43%); bias correction showed no gain, so it is parked.
implications: Shipped EC-BILL-UTILITY-DIVERGENCE-FROM-STATS-1 at v5.103.79; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.79.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: sensor.ura_energy_coordinator_predicted_bill prediction_source==utility and accuracy_cycles_scored>=1 after the 2026-11-24 cycle close, with accuracy_mape_by_horizon populated

refs.release_notes: The predicted bill now uses SmartHub's real cost so far plus a same-weekday forecast for the rest of the cycle, adds the service charge once, and keeps a per-cycle accuracy record (error at day 7, 14 and 21).
